svg.title: Iron Corridor national network concept
svg.desc: A concept map exploring Denver, Chicago and Houston as potential hubs, with five candidate corridor families across the continental United States. Connections are illustrative, not engineered routes, station sites, approved projects or an operating service. Dallas/Fort Worth is shown once, in Texas.
svg.text: Three proposed hubs. Regional corridors evaluated individually. No selected alignments.
Illustrative connections only · Approximate city centers · Land outlines: Natural Earth
